answer: Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The quill of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. A glacier of per-task receipts records who did what, and the walnut of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, converted to a slow vesting stream, rewards vest against future work.
